Brown Butter Sage Squash Pasta

Serves 4 · 45 minutes

4.5 stars from 12 reviews

Ingredients

  • 1 small butternut squash (about 2 lb), peeled and cubed
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • 10 fresh sage leaves
  • 12 oz short pasta
  • 1/3 cup grated pecorino
  • 1/8 tsp nutmeg

Directions

  1. Roast the squash.
  2. Brown the butter.
